info.name: Lists all webhooks for an account

params.name: page_size
params.description: A limit on the number of objects to be returned, between 1 and 100.

params.name: start_after
params.description: Returns a list of objects after the provided pagination cursor, using the next_cursor from the previous response.

params.name: end_before
params.description: Returns a list of objects that come before the provided pagination cursor. This is used for navigating to a previous page.

items.docs: Lists all of the webhook subscriptions that have been configured for your account.

info.name: Creates a new webhook for an account

items.docs: Creates a new webhook subscription for an account. This allows your application to receive real-time notifications for specific events.

info.name: Retrieves a webhook for an account

items.docs: Retrieves the details of a specific webhook subscription. Note the `ETag` header in the response, which is required for making updates or deletions.

info.name: Updates a webhook for an account

items.docs:
Updates the URL or the list of subscribed events for a webhook.

This endpoint uses optimistic locking. You must provide the webhook's current version in the `If-Match` header.
You can get this value from the `ETag` header of a `GET` request for this resource.

info.name: Deletes a webhook for an account

items.docs:
Permanently deletes a webhook subscription.

This endpoint uses optimistic locking. You must provide the webhook's current version in the `If-Match` header to confirm the deletion.
You can get this value from the `ETag` header of a `GET` request for this resource.

info.name: Returns webhook events history for replay and debugging purposes

params.name: delivery_status
params.description:
Filter by event delivery status.

Can be specified multiple times as a query parameter to return events
with multiple delivery statuses. If not provided,
events with all delivery statuses will be returned.

Example: "?delivery_status=pending&delivery_status=delivering"

params.name: type
params.description:
Filter by event type.

Can be used multiple times as query parameter to return events of multiple types. If not provided, events of all types will be returned.

Example: "?type=target-group-updated&type=quota-fill-registered"

params.name: end_time
params.description:
End time for retrieving webhook events. If not provided,
the current time will be used.

params.name: start_time
params.description: Start time from which to retrieve webhook events.

params.name: created_at_sort_order
params.description:
Sort order for webhook events based on creation time.
Use 'asc' for ascending order or 'desc' for descending order.

params.name: end_before
params.description: Returns a list of objects that come before the provided pagination cursor. This is used for navigating to a previous page.

items.docs: Returns webhook events history for replay and debugging purposes. Filter events by type, delivery status, and time range to analyze past webhook deliveries and replay failed events.

info.name: Regenerates the secret for a webhook

items.docs:
Immediately invalidates the old secret and generates a new one for a webhook.

**Important:** After regenerating, you must update your webhook handler with the new secret to continue verifying payloads. The old secret will no longer work.

info.name: List all available webhook event types

items.docs: Lists all of the event types you can subscribe to when creating or updating a webhook subscription.
